SearchHint.zh-CN: 搜索名称、目标、分组或备注
SearchHint.en: Search name, target, group or notes

Target.zh-CN: 路径、网址、应用标识或执行内容
Target.en: Path, URL, app ID or command content

EmptyTitle.en: Give your day a starting order

EmptyHint.zh-CN: 先新建一套方案，再添加软件、网站或文件。也可以将文件和快捷方式直接拖到这里。
EmptyHint.en: Create a plan, then add apps, websites or files. You can also drop files and shortcuts here.

InvalidInput.zh-CN: 请检查输入。时间须为 0 到 604800 秒的数字，重试次数须为 0 到 20 的整数。
InvalidInput.en: Check your input. Time must be 0–604800 seconds; retry count must be an integer from 0 to 20.

CorrectUrl.zh-CN:
网址需要 http:// 或 https://。是否改为：
{0}
CorrectUrl.en:
A URL needs http:// or https://. Use this address?
{0}

MissingSave.zh-CN: 当前找不到这个目标。仍然保存，稍后再重新定位吗？
MissingSave.en: This target does not currently exist. Save it and relocate it later?

CommandHint.zh-CN: 这里只保存执行内容；仅在明确运行时执行。PowerShell 使用 -NoProfile，不绕过执行策略。Cmd 内容遵循 cmd.exe 的引号和转义规则。
CommandHint.en: Content is saved without execution. PowerShell uses -NoProfile and respects execution policy. Cmd content follows cmd.exe quoting and escaping rules.

ItemSeconds.zh-CN: 启动前延迟 / 时间轴计划时间（秒）

WindowHint.zh-CN: 窗口状态是传给目标的启动建议；部分软件、商店应用和默认关联程序会忽略它。
WindowHint.en: Window state is a launch hint. Some apps, Store apps and default file handlers ignore it.

Arguments.zh-CN: 启动参数（保留所需引号）

RunAsAdmin.zh-CN: 对此项目请求管理员权限
RunAsAdmin.en: Request administrator rights for this item

DetectRunning.zh-CN: 检测普通软件或商店应用是否已运行
DetectRunning.en: Check whether this desktop / Store app is running

ProcessPath.zh-CN: 进程完整路径（留空自动识别）

ProcessName.zh-CN: 进程名（仅按名称判断，谨慎填写）

DetectionHint.zh-CN: 默认使用完整路径或商店应用标识。带参数的软件如未明确填写进程信息，将尝试启动并提示无法可靠去重。网站、文件、文件夹、快捷方式、脚本和命令不进行进程去重。
DetectionHint.en: Uses an exact path or Store app ID. Parameterized apps need explicit process identity for deduplication. Websites, files, folders, shortcuts, scripts and commands are not process-deduplicated.

SchedulingHelp.zh-CN:
顺序延迟：确认运行后，先等整体时间，再按列表逐项等各自延迟并提交启动请求；不等待软件准备完成。

统一时间轴：到期时刻 = 参考起点 + 整体等待 + 项目计划时间。登录时参考启序入口触发时间，手动时参考确认运行时间。选择方案前绝不执行；已经到期的项目按列表顺序尽快提交。同一时刻按列表顺序提交。重试不推迟后续项目。
SchedulingHelp.en:
Sequential: after confirmation, wait the overall delay, then each item's delay in list order. Do not wait for apps to become ready.

Timeline: due time = reference + overall delay + item offset. Login uses StartFlow entry time; manual runs use confirmation time. Nothing runs before confirmation. Overdue and equal-time items are submitted in list order. Retries do not postpone later items.

ChooseTitle.en: How would you like to begin?

ChooseHint.zh-CN: 选择一套方案，再点击运行。不操作会一直等待，不会自动执行。数量为启用数 / 总数。
ChooseHint.en: Select a plan, then click Run. StartFlow waits without a timeout. Counts show enabled / total.

LoginReference.zh-CN: 登录入口参考时间：{0}。这是启序收到登录启动入口的时间，并非精确系统登录时间。
LoginReference.en: Login reference: {0}. This is when StartFlow received its startup entry, not the exact Windows sign-in time.

CreateFirst.zh-CN: 在左侧点击“新建方案”开始。
CreateFirst.en: Click New plan in the sidebar to begin.

InstalledHint.zh-CN: 正在读取开始菜单和商店应用。可搜索后添加；无法确定入口的条目请手动选择文件。
InstalledHint.en: Reading Start menu and Store apps. Search and select an entry. If its launch target is unknown, choose a file manually.

ManualEntryRequired.zh-CN: 只能识别安装记录，无法可靠确定启动入口。请点击“浏览并选择目标”，不要选择卸载程序。
ManualEntryRequired.en: An installation record was found, but no reliable launch target. Browse for its executable; do not choose an uninstaller.

ReplaceConfirm.zh-CN: 替换当前全部配置？将先保存可恢复备份。系统登录启动设置不会随导入启用。
ReplaceConfirm.en: Replace all current configuration? A recovery backup will be saved. Import never enables Windows startup.

ImportWarning.zh-CN: 请核对所有目标、命令、脚本、参数、管理员权限和私人路径。来源不可信时请取消。导入只保存配置，不执行项目，也不改变 Windows 登录启动开关。换电脑后请编辑不存在的路径。
ImportWarning.en: Review every target, command, script, argument, administrator option and private path. Cancel if you do not trust the source. Import saves configuration without running items or changing Windows startup. Edit missing paths after moving computers.

PlanSummary.zh-CN: {0} 项启用 / 共 {1} 项  ·  {2}  ·  整体等待 {3} 秒

SaveFailed.zh-CN: 保存失败。请检查目录权限和磁盘空间；现有文件未被直接覆盖。
SaveFailed.en: Save failed. Check folder permissions and free space. Existing files are not overwritten in place.

DuplicateConfirm.zh-CN: 方案中已存在相同类型、目标和关键参数的项目。仍要添加“{0}”吗？
DuplicateConfirm.en: This plan already contains this target, type and key arguments. Add “{0}” anyway?

DeletePlanConfirm.zh-CN: 删除方案“{0}”及其项目？不会删除项目引用的文件。
DeletePlanConfirm.en: Delete plan “{0}” and its entries? Referenced files will remain on disk.

DeleteItemsConfirm.zh-CN: 删除所选 {0} 个项目？不会删除引用的文件。
DeleteItemsConfirm.en: Delete {0} selected entries? Referenced files will remain on disk.

ReorderHint.zh-CN: 请先清空搜索并关闭分组视图，再调整实际执行顺序。
ReorderHint.en: Clear the search and turn off grouping before changing execution order.

DuplicateQueue.zh-CN: 该方案已在运行或等待，或队列已达 20 套。请等待或先停止，避免重复排队。
DuplicateQueue.en: This plan is already running / queued, or the queue has reached 20 plans. Wait or stop before adding it again.

RunningSummary.zh-CN: 正在执行“{0}” · 等待 {1} 套。停止会取消未启动项目和重试，保留已打开的目标。
RunningSummary.en: Running “{0}” · {1} queued. Stop cancels pending items and retries, leaving launched targets open.

ReadyHint.zh-CN: 准备就绪 · 点击运行才会执行。软件成功表示请求已提交；网页加载和目标窗口行为由目标决定。
ReadyHint.en: Ready · Items run only after confirmation. Success means the request was submitted; loading and window behavior depend on the target.

SkipArmed.zh-CN: 已设置：仅下一次新登录跳过选择流程。同一登录会话内重启软件不会消费此设置。
SkipArmed.en: Armed for the next new sign-in. Restarting StartFlow in the current sign-in does not consume the skip.

ProjectHome.zh-CN: 打开 GitHub 项目主页

ProjectNotSet.zh-CN: 请在常规设置中填写有效的 GitHub 地址。官方项目：https://github.com/you2032zhu/StartFlow
ProjectNotSet.en: Set a valid GitHub URL in General settings. Official project: https://github.com/you2032zhu/StartFlow

LoginStartup.zh-CN: 登录 Windows 后启动启序

StartupCorrect.zh-CN: 系统入口已验证，路径与当前程序一致。
StartupCorrect.en: Verified: Windows startup points to this executable.

StartupStale.zh-CN: 已有登录入口，但路径与当前程序不一致。便携版移动后请点击修复。
StartupStale.en: A startup entry exists, but points elsewhere. Repair it after moving the portable folder.

DisabledByWindows.zh-CN: 入口已保存，但 Windows 已在“启动应用”中禁用启序。请在 Windows 设置 → 应用 → 启动中手动开启。
DisabledByWindows.en: The entry is saved, but Windows disabled it in Startup apps. Enable it manually in Windows Settings → Apps → Startup.

StartupHint.zh-CN: 使用当前用户 Run 入口，无需整机管理员权限。睡眠唤醒与解锁不会重新执行。Windows 可能自行延迟启动应用。安装版和便携版共享一个真实启动入口。
StartupHint.en: Uses the current-user Run key without machine-wide elevation. Sleep and unlock do not rerun it. Windows may delay startup apps. Installed and portable copies share one real startup entry.

PrivacyHint.zh-CN: 仅本地配置，无账号、遥测、广告或后台更新检查。请勿在参数、备注或命令中保存密码与令牌。
PrivacyHint.en: Local configuration only. No account, telemetry, ads or background update checks. Do not store passwords or tokens in arguments, notes or commands.

ImportDone.zh-CN: 导入已完成。未运行任何项目；请检查无效路径。替换前的备份保存在当前数据目录。
ImportDone.en: Import complete. No items were run. Check missing paths; pre-replacement backups are in the data folder.

ExportWarning.zh-CN: 分享前检查并编辑私人路径、网址、参数、脚本、命令和备注。配置不会主动添加密码、令牌或无关系统信息；您手写的内容仍会原样包含。
ExportWarning.en: Review and edit private paths, URLs, arguments, scripts, commands and notes before sharing. StartFlow adds no passwords, tokens or unrelated system information, but your own text is included verbatim.

TestConfirm.zh-CN: 立即实际启动所选项目？脚本、命令和管理员请求也会真实执行。
TestConfirm.en: Launch the selected item now? Scripts, commands and administrator requests will really execute.

CloseHint.zh-CN: 是否留在托盘继续等待任务？可在设置中重新修改。
CloseHint.en: Keep StartFlow in the tray? You can change this in Settings.

RecoveryPrompt.zh-CN: 配置无法正常读取。是否使用备份或空配置恢复？原文件会另外保留为 recovery 文件，确认后才保存。取消会退出，便于手动恢复。
RecoveryPrompt.en: Configuration could not be read. Recover using the backup or an empty configuration? The original is preserved as a recovery file before saving. Cancel exits so you can recover manually.

StartupFailure.zh-CN: 启动失败。便携版请完整解压到可写文件夹；检查配置目录权限。原配置不会被静默覆盖。
StartupFailure.en: Startup failed. Extract the portable package into a writable folder and check data folder permissions. Existing configuration is not silently overwritten.

HelpLocation.zh-CN: 请查看交付目录 docs 中的《用户与制作教程.md》。
HelpLocation.en: See docs/用户与制作教程.md in the distribution.

NameRequired.zh-CN: 请填写名称（不超过 200 字符）。

TargetRequired.zh-CN: 请填写目标或执行内容。
TargetRequired.en: Enter a target or command content.

InvalidTiming.zh-CN: 时间须为 0–604800 秒，重试次数须为 0–20。
InvalidTiming.en: Time must be 0–604800 seconds and retries 0–20.

InvalidUrl.zh-CN: 请输入有效的 http:// 或 https:// 地址，不应在网址中包含用户名密码。
InvalidUrl.en: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL without embedded credentials.

InvalidAppId.zh-CN: 商店应用需要有效的 AUMID（包家族名!应用标识）。请从已安装应用中选择。
InvalidAppId.en: Store apps need an AUMID (package family!app ID). Choose one from Installed apps.

AdminUnsupported.zh-CN: 此类型不支持管理员选项，请关闭该选项。
AdminUnsupported.en: This target type does not support administrator launch.

ParameterizedDetection.zh-CN: 带参数的软件需关闭去重，或明确填写进程信息。
ParameterizedDetection.en: For parameterized apps, disable deduplication or specify process identity.

MissingTarget.zh-CN: 目标不存在。请编辑项目并重新选择路径。
MissingTarget.en: Target does not exist. Edit the item and select its new path.

AlreadyRunning.zh-CN: 已检测到相同进程路径或应用标识。
AlreadyRunning.en: An exact process path or app identity is already running.

StoreSubmitted.zh-CN: 商店应用激活请求已提交；窗口状态由目标决定。
StoreSubmitted.en: Store activation submitted; the target controls its window state.

ExitUnavailable.zh-CN: 请求已提交，但无法取得进程退出结果。
ExitUnavailable.en: Request submitted; exit result is unavailable.

ProcessCreated.zh-CN: 脚本或命令进程已创建，尚未取得退出结果。
ProcessCreated.en: Script / command process created; exit result is pending.

DetectionUnknown.zh-CN: 无法可靠判断是否已运行，已尝试启动。可能受权限或参数限制。
DetectionUnknown.en: Running-state detection was inconclusive; launch attempted. Permissions or arguments may prevent reliable detection.

RequestSubmitted.zh-CN: Windows 已接受启动请求，不表示软件或网页已经加载完成。
RequestSubmitted.en: Windows accepted the launch request. This does not confirm app readiness or page load.

UacCancelled.zh-CN: 用户取消了管理员权限请求；不会自动重试。
UacCancelled.en: Administrator request was cancelled; it will not retry automatically.

StoreDetectionUnknown.zh-CN: 商店激活请求已提交；因进程访问限制，无法可靠判断此前是否运行。
StoreDetectionUnknown.en: Store activation submitted; process access restrictions prevented reliable running-state detection.

ExportReservedPath.zh-CN: 此文件名由启序用于配置或恢复。请选择其他目录或文件名导出，避免覆盖正在使用的数据。
ExportReservedPath.en: This filename is reserved for live configuration or recovery. Export to a different folder or filename.
